question.:question/problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{2}+7{x}_{1} &=2{x}_{3} \\ -12{x}_{3} &=12\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}7{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3} &=0 \\ 0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}-12{x}_{3} &=12\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}7 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -12\end{bmatrix}
$$

question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}a-c &=6b \\ 14c-13a &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}1a-6b-1c &=0 \\ -13a+0b+14c &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}1 & -6 & -1 \\ -13 & 0 & 14\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -6 & -1 & 0 \\ -13 & 0 & 14 & -1\end{array}\right]
$$

knowledge_point.title: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z

question.:question/problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-13{x}_{2} &=-5 \\ -11{x}_{3}+10{x}_{1} &=7{x}_{2}\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}0{x}_{1}-13{x}_{2}+0{x}_{3} &=-5 \\ 10{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3} &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}0 & -13 & 0 \\ 10 & -7 & -11\end{bmatrix}
$$
